title: MuSeR: Scalable Long-sequence Recommendation with Multi-interest Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.23677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ultra-long user behavior sequences carry rich signals of stable and diverse preferences, yet industrial recommender systems typically truncate histories to a few hundred actions under strict latency and memory budgets, leaving long-term interests under-utilized. Users also pursue multiple heterogeneous intents across modalities such as news, Q&A, and short video, which sparse ID embeddings alone struggle to represent. We present Multi-interest Sequence Representation (MuSeR), a retrieval framework built on the deployed MGS system, which integrates three components: (i) hierarchical temporal compression, which retains recent actions at full resolution while progressively pooling older segments, so that per-user histories of $10^{4}$-$10^{5}$ interactions fit within a fixed serving budget; (ii) disentangled multi-query interest extraction with orthogonality regularization; and (iii) multimodal semantic alignment, which augments sparse item

translated_title: MuSeR：基于多兴趣建模的可扩展长序列推荐
translated_abstract: 超长用户行为序列蕴含着丰富且稳定的多样化偏好信号，然而在严格的延迟和内存预算下，工业推荐系统通常将历史行为截断为几百条记录，导致长期兴趣未被充分利用。此外，用户还会在新闻、问答、短视频等多种模态中追求多种异质意图，仅靠稀疏的ID嵌入难以表达这些意图。我们提出了多兴趣序列表示（MuSeR），这是一个构建在已部署的MGS系统之上的检索框架，它集成了三个组件：(i) 分层时间压缩，以全分辨率保留近期行为，同时逐步池化较旧的片段，使得每个用户10^4-10^5次交互的历史能够适应固定的服务预算；(ii) 带有正交性正则化的解耦多查询兴趣提取；以及 (iii) 多模态语义对齐，通过多模态语义信息增强稀疏的物品……
tldr: MuSeR提出了一种融合分层时间压缩、解耦多兴趣提取和多模态语义对齐的检索框架，使工业推荐系统能够在固定服务预算内处理超长用户行为序列并充分挖掘长期多样化兴趣。
en_tdlr: MuSeR is a retrieval framework combining hierarchical temporal compression, disentangled multi-interest extraction, and multimodal semantic alignment, enabling industrial recommenders to process ultra-long user behavior sequences within a fixed serving budget while fully exploiting long-term diverse interests.
